title: Nne Ahorow a Ɛwɔ Nsu a Ɛnyɛ Den no Akyi
intro: Fa w’adwene bu mpɔtam bi a ɛnyɛ kurow anaa sodifo bi nti na wɔato din, na mmom nsu a ɛyɛ komm a nkwa atwa ho ahyia no din. Nkyekyem kakraa bi pɛ na wɔkae mpɔtam ha yi, a bere nyinaa wɔbobɔ wɔn din wɔ wɔn a wɔpoo akwankyerɛ no ho. Tie bere a wɔrekasa afi sum mu no.
clues: Yɛyɛ mpɔtam bi a wɔabɔ din wɔ Kur’aan mu, nanso yɛn asɛm mũ no nyinaa da so ara yɛ ahintasɛm akata so.
Wɔka yɛn ho asɛm bere nyinaa ka wɔn a wɔpowee no ho, te sɛ Ad ne Thamudfo no.
Wɔfrɛ yɛn Ar-Rass Ahokafoɔ, Abura a na yɛn nkwa wɔ ho no.
Yɛpoo ɔbɔfo a wɔde akwankyerɛ a emu da hɔ kɔmaa yɛn no.
Wokan yen ka nkurafoa a wopoo asomafoa a Allah asoma won nyinaa no ho.
Yehyiaa ahunahuna a ɛbaa mu wɔ obiara a ɔpow biribiara a odii yɛn anim no so, ɔsɛe ma yɛn pow.

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
